Category: Wealth management: fees on client balances
What NovaFin would put money into: Wealth management (sample book: ₹328.1 crore of client investment balances)
Return range (% a year): 1.39 (bad year) to 1.80 (no churn), per ₹ of client balances
How the bad year is defined: Market fall of 20% (balances and fees fall with it) and churn twice as high
Evidence strength: Medium: fee yield read from the CLV formula (exact fit); churn can't be predicted
How fast the money can come back: Client money stays with clients; fees arrive yearly
Data gap or assumption: Per ₹ of client balances, not of NovaFin's capital; return per ₹ of capital comes from Module 1's Wealth unit (17.6% a year)
Controls: No model-driven retention until a randomised test; contact list for high-value customers
